title: DINOv3-PEFT: A Dual-Branch Collaborative Network with Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Precise Road Segmentation in SAR Imagery
mechanism: PEFT-tuned DINOv3 branch for context paired with a second branch for fine spatial detail, fused for thin road segmentation in speckled greyscale SAR.
adaptation: Thin lines in greyscale non-natural images is the closest domain match found. Use its dual-branch fusion as the template for the CNN detail branch of VFM-H: ResNet-34 stride-2/4 features fused with DINOv3 tokens upsampled from 1024 px input.
min_experiment: Arm: VFM-H with the detail branch vs without it, same PEFT. Baseline: house PF and the no-branch arm. Metric: CV crack relF1@2 and crack IoU. Kill: branch adds less than 0.01 relF1@2 over no-branch AND the arm is below PF.
evidence: R: abstract fragment only; SAR road extraction; numbers not read.
prior_overlap: none: Om's A1 (DINOv3 + HR CNN branch) was dropped on the A8 KILL, not tested.

alt_notes.adaptation: Fusion pattern only: house ResNet-34 stream plus DINOv3 ViT adapter stream fused at stride 4 and 8 inside U-Net++; fallback for ViTC-UNet if its cross-attention is unstable on 478 cells.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Run as the fusion variant of the ViTC-UNet arm; same baseline (house PF), metrics and kill line (E1 crack relF1@2 < +0.03 or CV crack IoU drop > 0.012). About 20 GPU-h.

alt_notes.adaptation: Closest domain found (thin lines in noisy greyscale). CNN branch = house R34 under PF; implement its fusion module from the paper in VFM-H.
alt_notes.min_experiment: VFM-H with its fusion vs plain additive fusion; CV crack relF1@2 and E1 relF1@2; kill if below plain fusion on both.
